sloka: शोकदुःखभयत्रस्ता विह्वलाश्च सुमध्यमाः ।तासां निश्वासवातेन सर्वतः सम्प्रदीपितम् ।। ७.२४.९ ॥
transliteration: śokaduḥkhabhayatrastā vihvalāśca sumadhyamāḥ ।tāsāṁ niśvāsavātena sarvataḥ sampradīpitam ।। 7.24.9 ॥

translations.english: These slender-waisted women, distressed by sorrow, misery, and fear, were so agitated that the very atmosphere around them was inflamed by the wind of their sighs.
